es.title: Noticias de Copyright e Inteligencia Artificial
es.subtitle: Notas publicadas por medios reales de la industria, con liga al artículo original. Sin noticias inventadas.

items.title: DistroKid’s $2 billion valuation based on it being a pipeline for AI slop and copyright infringement, says Universal
items.summary: Universal claims that distributor DistroKid achieved its recent $2 billion valuation by providing a pipeline for AI slop and copyright infringing music, to the detriment of artists and labels. It has filed a lawsuit accusing DistroKid of copyright infringement and unlawful deceptive trade practices

items.title: UMG, Sony Hit Suno With New Copyright Lawsuit Days After AI Model Launch
Landmark termination rights ruling not the “copyright emergency” music publishers claim, songwriter tells US Supreme Court
items.summary: When America’s Fifth Circuit Appeals Court backed a songwriter-friendly interpretation of the termination right in US copyright law, the majors bought the song that prompted that ruling and asked the Supreme Court to intervene. The writer of that song has now urged the top court to not get involved

items.title: Universal Music demanda a DistroKid por copyright y música creada con IA
UMG and Sony Music file new Suno complaint over v6 models
items.summary: In our recent report on Suno’s new v6 models, we explained that they were trained on a fresh dataset including music licensed from WMG and BMG, plus “user data”. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: ¿De quién es la música? Derechos de autor en la era de la inteligencia artificial
Universal and Warner tell judge ‘new use’ clause in AFM agreement is “clear and unambiguous” and does not apply to their AI deals
items.summary: In June the American Federation Of Musicians sued Universal and Warner over their AI deals, insisting the majors should be sharing their AI money with the union’s members under its Sound Recording Labor Agreement. Both sides have made new court filings as the majors try to get the lawsuit dismissed

items.title: UMG demanda a DistroKid por ‘slop’ de IA y violación de derechos de autor
Snapchat has a new GenAI-powered ‘Chat to Song’ feature
items.summary: Earlier this year, we wrote about the ‘text-to-song’ craze on TikTok, where people were feeding their message-threads into Suno to generate songs – some of which went viral. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Italy’s Sanremo Music Festival bars AI if it replaces human creativity
items.summary: The Sanremo Music Festival is a veritable institution in Italy: an annual music contest and TV broadcast that’s often had a secondary purpose of choosing Italy’s entry for the next Eurovision Song Contest. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Universal y Sony llevan a Suno ante los tribunales por el uso de miles de canciones para entrenar su IA
Universal Music Group stock reacts to new AI lawsuit against Suno

tip.title: Antes de firmar, revisa la reversión de derechos
tip.body: La pregunta clave de cualquier contrato no es cuánto te dan hoy, sino cuándo y cómo recuperas tu obra. Si no hay cláusula de reversión, estás cediendo por el plazo completo.

tip.title: Before signing, check the reversion clause
tip.body: The key question in any deal isn't what you get today —it's when and how you get your work back. With no reversion clause, you're assigning for the full term.
